public-holiday lookup for the calendar
detail: _loadCalHols() fetches a public holiday feed; every outbound host is denied by this sandbox and blocked deliberately by the harness. The failure PATH is covered — the calendar renders all twelve months with no holiday data at all.

feature: a real notification actually firing for a due reminder
detail: Notifications need a granted permission and a real service-worker registration on a real origin. The stored reminder, its states and its ordering are measured above; the delivery is not, and is not reported as if it were.
